ctx.x: Did he use that even then?

Yeah! He had that for ages. And you know, I actually hadn't heard him in person until the first time I went to hear him... He was at the Lafayette. I think he had Tubby Hall playing drums with him at that time -- that's how I remember it. And Lester Boone, I think, was in the band. Zilner Randolph maybe. Well, anyhow, I went to hear him, because everybody was just talking so much about him, and by this time I really had my feathers up, because I just was mowin' 'em down left and right! -- heh-heh-heh!

So I caught the first show, and I say, "She-ei-i... Is this what they've been shouting about? Get out of here!" And I started to get up and go out, and then I said, ""Wait a minute; this is his first show." And I put myself in his position. Suppose he hung out, and his chops ain't cool, you know. I'd better stay and catch the next show. You know, I figured... I know about that trumpet, man. It can be a devil! It's a bad fella! So I stayed the second show, and it got a little better, you know.
Yeah, that was the Grand Terrace Graham Harris band.
